objective: Execute Phase 11 Blockbuster World Quality Audit across all 17 registered environments, diagnosing visual shortcomings, measuring real engine performance and presets, ranking worlds, authoring the blockbuster art-quality standard and prioritized improvement backlog
acceptance_criteria: Ground on clean commit c45fe3f on origin/main without assumptions
Audit every registered world (all 17) across architectural identity, lighting, landmarks, depth, animation, procedural variety, train consistency, presets, mobile readability, and performance
Collect real browser camera screenshots and telemetry across beginning (Z=-50m), middle (Z=-1000m), and late-game (Z=-2200m+)
Evaluate graphics quality presets LOW and AUTO to verify scenery retention and visual degradation
Perform root cause analysis of visual deficiencies (box architecture, repetitive geometry, pop-in, flat lighting, weak silhouettes)
Independently score and rank all 17 worlds across 9 criteria; compare Chrono Kingdom, Inferno Express, Jurassic Rush, Haunted Carnival, Midnight Velvet, Mitron Express, Rahulverse vs others
Identify 3 highest-potential worlds, 3 weakest implementations, and 3 shared core engineering/art problems
Produce docs/theme-blockbuster/ART_QUALITY_STANDARD.md with practical art bible and budgets
Produce prioritized improvement backlog with world, defect, root cause, solution, risk, files, effort
Strictly maintain zero gameplay code changes (no edits to player physics, collision, track mechanics)
Push verified documentation and audit tooling directly to origin/main
non_goals: Do not modify gameplay code, collision bounding boxes, speed, or player physics
Do not invent measured performance numbers or screenshot evidence
Do not assign uniform inflated scores across worlds
